title: VOLTHAVEN
note: Wave 1 was killed mid-flight by an account session limit — all ten builders terminated before finishing. Three had written real code by then. Everything else is still a stub. Revised plan: sequential builds, 2-3 agents at a time, not ten.
blockers: HARD BLOCKER: the ten parallel builders exhausted the account session limit within minutes and all ten were terminated by the API. Limit resets 21:40 UTC. Fan-out width is the cause — the retry runs 2-3 agents at a time.
GitHub repo creation returned 403 (this app has no repo-creation scope). Work is pushed to claude/cyberpunk-threejs-game-aytbja on clonevpn333-bot/game.
cdnjs is blocked by sandbox egress policy. Shipped HTML still loads three.js r128 from cdnjs; the capture harness serves a byte-identical copy locally.
Real Cyberpunk 2077 screenshots cannot be fetched (egress). Blind A/B would run against each critic reference knowledge — no critic has run yet.

pieces.name: Render core & post FX
pieces.verdict: Not shippable yet — self-assessed, no critic has run
pieces.gap: The full post chain (SSAO, SSR, volumetrics, 6-mip bloom, ACES + grade, FXAA) is architected and runs at 146 draw calls with a clean console, but it was never tuned. Emissive surfaces clip to flat white with no bloom halo, and the test camera points at the sky dome instead of the street, so the frame is 70% empty navy.
